[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum Average Subarray I** [LC 643 · Maximum Average Subarray I](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-average-subarray-i/){difficulty="Easy"}

Every window has the same length $k$, so maximising the average is the same as maximising the **sum** — the division by $k$ never changes which window wins. The windows overlap by $k-1$ elements: the window $[l+1..l+k]$ is the window $[l..l+k-1]$ minus its leftmost element plus its new rightmost. You never need to re-add $k$ numbers; you carry one running sum and swap one term at each step. That single "drop the leaver, add the enterer" move is the whole sliding window.

[Solved in full in @sec-sw-p1-a.]{.card-link}

:::
